name: embedding dim contract: index reads the provider, loud on mismatch

targets_met.1_one_dim_authority: from_storage_dir resolves dim ONCE from the active embedder via _resolve_embedding_dim(embedder) (moneta_store.py:266); both construction paths (:275 primary, :305 no-USD retry) feed embedding_dim=dim. targets_met.2_stale_snapshot_rebuild: _reconcile_snapshot_dim re-embeds each snapshot row's source payload at the live dim and rewrites snapshot.json atomically BEFORE Moneta hydrates, so a provider change rebuilds the derived vectors instead of aborting into fallback. No memory dropped (payload is the source of truth; only the derived vector is recomputed).

findings.claim: LIVE PRODUCTION SEAT IS CURRENTLY DEGRADED BY THIS BUG. The running Houdini seat's doctor reports moneta_substrate=fail / write_plane=degraded because backend moneta FELL BACK to jsonl with reason 'ValueError: embedding dim mismatch: expected 384, got 256' at houdini_temp/untitled/.synapse. This bug is not hypothetical; it is active now. Merging this fix + restarting the server recovers the moneta backend on that seat.

VENDOR (Moneta) root cause, boundary respected (NO in-place edit). Moneta.__init__ rebuilds its shadow vector index from hydrated ECS semantic_vectors without validating against config.embedding_dim (api.py:229-236), so a provider change trips the vendor upsert dim-guard (vector_index.py:112) and Moneta(cfg) raises a bare ValueError inside its constructor. The persisted vectors are DERIVED data. See held moneta-side spawn.

PROCESS HYGIENE (dual-launch near-miss, recovered). My edits initially landed on the MAIN worktree (C:/Users/User/SYNAPSE, branch master) instead of the wave3/dim worktree, and a CONCURRENT agent was active there (untracked .filemap.json, docs/_filemap_dump.json, docs/_probe_tmp.md). Recovered cleanly: extracted the diff, applied it to the correct worktree, git-restored moneta_store.py + removed only my own test on the main tree, leaving the other agent's files untouched. Main tree verified clean of my changes afterward.

BENIGN (not a dim issue). The isolated same-process probe logged one 'use_real_usd=True failed (SdfLayer already exists ...cortex_root.usda); retrying without USD sublayers' -- a pxr layer-identity reuse within one process when a seed store and a reopen share a usd dir. The pre-existing no-USD retry path handled it; moneta still served and count was preserved. Does not occur across real process boundaries and is orthogonal to the dim contract.
